dogecoin.text: 21Shares files for a spot Dogecoin ETF in the US, following Bitwise & Grayscale’s moves. If approved, it could boost DOGE’s institutional adoption. #Dogecoin #Crypto
Grayscale advances Dogecoin ETF plans—files for "GDOG" under 1933 Act, betting on meme coin institutionalization. First-ever DOGE ETF could launch by mid-2026. #Dogecoin #ETF
